newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian vehicle sales rise in January.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian vehicle sales rise in January.

text.p: Australian new vehicle sales totalled 45,741 in January, up eight percent from 42,340 in January 1996, but were down 17.3 percent from December's 55,332, The Federal Chamber of Automotive Industries (FCAI) reported.
"All segments, with the exception of the small cars segment followed this seasonal (low fleet activity) trend," the industry organisation said in its monthly VFACTS publication on Friday.
The FCAI did not alter its forecast for 1997 total sales of 630,000 vehicles, down about 20,000 or three percent on 1996.

Mitsubishi Motors Corp, the fourth car manufacturer in Australia, sold 5,873 vehicles in January 1997 for a market share of 12.8 percent, up from 3,482 in January 1996 and a market share of 8.2 percent.

The rest of the sales were made up by imports, led by South Korea's Hyundai Motor Co with sales of 5,236 and a market share of 11.4 percent compared to sales of 3,653 vehicles for a market share of 8.6 percent in January 1996.
